title: Identify the lifestyle
hint: Two words: the lifestyle that aims to produce no trash.

ja.prompt: ゴミを出さない生活様式は何ですか？
ja.hint: ゴミを出さないことを目指す、二語の言葉で答えましょう。

local.hint: Two words: the lifestyle that aims to produce no trash.

zh.prompt: 哪种生活方式可以避免产生垃圾？
zh.hint: 两词：旨在不产生垃圾的生活方式。

en.hint: Two words: the lifestyle that aims to produce no trash.

title: Simple change to reduce trash
prompt: Give one simple change to reduce the amount of trash.
hint: Think of a small swap for shopping: reuse a bag.

ja.prompt: ゴミを減らすための簡単な一つの変化を言ってください。
ja.hint: 買い物のときの小さな切り替えを考えてください：袋を使い回すなど。

local.prompt: Give one simple change to reduce the amount of trash.
local.hint: Think of a small swap for shopping: reuse a bag.

local_pron.prompt: ɡɪv wʌn ˈsɪmpəl ʧeɪnʤ tuː rɪˈdjuːs ði əˈmaʊnt əv træʃ.
local_pron.hint: θɪŋk əv ə smɔːl swæp fɔr ˈʃɑpɪŋ: rɪˈjuːz ə bæɡ.

zh.prompt: 說出一個簡單的改變以減少垃圾量。
zh.hint: 想一個購物時的小替代：重複使用購物袋。
zh.sample: 使用可重複使用的袋子。

en.prompt: Give one simple change to reduce the amount of trash.
en.hint: Think of a small swap for shopping: reuse a bag.

title: First step to understand your trash
prompt: What is the first step to understand what you throw away?
hint: The material says to begin by examining your garbage closely.
sample: Look at your trash to understand it.

ja.prompt: 自分が捨てるものを理解するための最初のステップは何ですか？
ja.hint: 資料には、まずゴミをよく見て調べると書かれています。
ja.sample: ゴミをよく見て理解することです。

local.prompt: What is the first step to understand what you throw away?
local.hint: The material says to begin by examining your garbage closely.
local.sample: Look at your trash to understand it.

local_pron.prompt: wʌt ɪz ðə fɜrst stɛp tuː ʌndərˈstænd wʌt juː θroʊ əˈweɪ?
local_pron.hint: ðə məˈtɪriəl sez tuː bɪˈgɪn baɪ ɪɡˈzæmənɪŋ jɔr ˈɡɑrbɪdʒ kloʊsli.
local_pron.sample: lʊk æt jɔr træʃ tuː ˌʌndərˈstænd ɪt.

zh.prompt: 要了解你丟棄的東西，第一步是什麼？
zh.hint: 材料說要從仔細檢視你的垃圾開始。
zh.sample: 查看你的垃圾以了解它。

en.prompt: What is the first step to understand what you throw away?
en.hint: The material says to begin by examining your garbage closely.
en.sample: Look at your trash to understand it.
